non_blocking_concerns: runBuildStepRecommendation is awaited inside the main step try/catch; if a future regression causes it to throw outside its internal guards, the step could be marked failed and halt the run
Logger methods are invoked directly; if a non-function logger is passed, a TypeError could propagate (helper does not guard against non-callable logger fields)
If the hub later performs remote calls, the awaited hook could add latency to the build step (recommend_only implies it should remain quick/timeout-bounded)
hub_bundle_concerns: MessageBus is instantiated but unused (minor: harmless overhead)
No explicit dispose/reset of hub internals beyond replacing the singleton; acceptable since no listeners/timers are attached, but worth noting for future extensions
Object.freeze is used in production bundle; tests’ inline reproduction does not freeze (not harmful, but test doesn’t assert immutability)
call_site_concerns: The hook is placed after setting statuses[i] = 'complete' but before DB persistence/logAction; if the hook ever becomes slow, persistence/logging could be delayed
Single canonical call site confirmed; however no explicit guard exists to prevent accidental future reuse outside the build guard beyond static regex checks
test_coverage_gaps: No explicit runtime test that non-build steps do not invoke the hook (only static-source regex)
No test path simulating orchestrator bundle bootstrap failure to confirm non-blocking behavior/logging
Static assertions do not verify the exact relative ordering (after statuses[i] = 'complete') to guard against reordering regressions
architecture_concerns: Deferring server-side step-owner registration means the browser path will be a no-op indefinitely until wired; consider telemetry beyond console logs to detect prolonged absence
Future shift to server invocation must enforce strict timeouts to preserve recommend_only non-blocking semantics
Full recommendation objects are logged to console; confirm no sensitive artifact data will leak in production logs
regression_concerns: AutoRunner.jsx also contains unrelated changes (e.g., fetch-failure handling); ensure those are intended for this dispatch
New imports and exports slightly grow the browser bundle, though impact appears minimal
nice_to_have_tweaks: 1) Wrap the await runBuildStepRecommendation call in its own try/catch or move it outside the main step try to belt-and-suspenders enforce non-blocking even if the helper regresses
2) Harden logger calls by verifying functions before invocation (e.g., typeof logger.warn === 'function') to avoid rare TypeErrors
3) Add a short timeout inside runBuildStepRecommendation (Promise.race) so any future remote hub behavior cannot stall the build step
4) Extend static-source assertions to verify the hook appears after statuses[i] = 'complete' to lock in post-compute placement
5) Add a negative test that non-build steps never call invokeStepOwner (e.g., scan source or simulate other steps) and a test for bundle bootstrap failure handling
